886a465947.en: A read of the 2024 HKSTP Symposium on Innovative Robotics and Applications: academic and industry labs (heavy UC Berkeley presence) on fusing AI foundation models (LLMs / VLMs) with robot perception, planning and manipulation — task-oriented grasping, human-robot collaboration and safety, tactile and wearable sensing, robust autonomy, and smart transport for Hong Kong.
886a465947.zh: 对 2024 HKSTP Symposium on Innovative Robotics and Applications 的解读：学术界和产业界实验室（加州大学伯克利分校占比很高）围绕将 AI 基础模型（大语言模型 / 视觉语言模型）与机器人感知、规划和操作相融合展开——任务导向抓取、人机协作与安全、触觉与可穿戴传感、鲁棒自主，以及香港的智能交通。

bae8d80508.en: {1}About:{/1} A one-day HKSTP symposium at Hong Kong Science Park's INNO², pairing academic robotics talks with industry perspectives on robotics and applications.
bae8d80508.zh: {1}关于：{/1}HKSTP 在香港科学园 INNO² 举办的为期一天的研讨会，将学术界的机器人报告与产业界对机器人及其应用的看法结合起来。

665a57dd7b.en: The dominant thread is fusing foundation models (LLMs / VLMs) with robot perception, planning and manipulation — especially task-oriented grasping, human-robot collaboration & safety, and tactile / wearable sensing — alongside robust autonomy and smart transport for Hong Kong.
665a57dd7b.zh: 主线是将基础模型（大语言模型 / 视觉语言模型）与机器人感知、规划和操作相融合——尤其是任务导向抓取、人机协作与安全、触觉 / 可穿戴传感——同时涉及鲁棒自主和香港的智能交通。

f810831834.en: Generalizable Task-Oriented Grasping with Foundation Models
f810831834.zh: Generalizable Task-Oriented Grasping with Foundation Models

bee37bc415.zh: {1}Hong Zhang{/1} · 任务导向抓取 · FoundationGrasp

2edce36964.en: Task-Oriented Grasping (TOG) = decide which object to grasp and how; learning beats classical grasping but is data-hungry
2edce36964.zh: 任务导向抓取（TOG）= 决定抓取哪个物体以及如何抓取；学习方法优于传统抓取，但依赖大量数据

f9a57dcbbb.en: Use foundation models (LLMs + VLMs) to transfer knowledge and generalize across novel objects, tasks and grippers
f9a57dcbbb.zh: 利用基础模型（大语言模型 + 视觉语言模型）迁移知识，并泛化到新的物体、任务和夹爪

e0f8ecb367.en: Goal: from an RGB image + a language instruction (object + task) + gripper geometry, output a 6-DoF grasp pose
e0f8ecb367.zh: 目标：根据 RGB 图像 + 语言指令（物体 + 任务）+ 夹爪几何形状，输出 6 自由度抓取位姿

2b73d90230.en: Pipeline: data generation → multi-modal feature representation → task-oriented grasp evaluation → loss
2b73d90230.zh: 流水线：数据生成 → 多模态特征表示 → 任务导向抓取评估 → 损失

97492205ac.en: Object/grasp encoder (PointNet++), semantic encoder (BERT), geometric encoder (CLIP), trained with binary cross-entropy
97492205ac.zh: 物体 / 抓取编码器（PointNet++）、语义编码器（BERT）、几何编码器（CLIP），使用二元交叉熵训练

d38df71524.en: LLM prompts generate language descriptions; web image retrieval augments visual diversity
d38df71524.zh: 用大语言模型提示词生成语言描述；通过网络图像检索增加视觉多样性

0491d8b4f7.en: GraspCLIP reaches ~83% mAP but struggles on novel classes; FoundationGrasp adds commonsense reasoning
0491d8b4f7.zh: GraspCLIP 达到约 83% mAP，但在新类别上表现不佳；FoundationGrasp 加入了常识推理

29c389c901.en: ~90% grasp success across nine manipulation tasks, but full-manipulation success ~67% (limited relative-pose modeling, no force feedback)
29c389c901.zh: 九个操作任务中抓取成功率约 90%，但完整操作成功率约 67%（相对位姿建模有限，没有力反馈）

b7d06bbcd4.en: Ablations: geometric knowledge is key for novel instances, semantic knowledge for novel tasks
b7d06bbcd4.zh: 消融实验：几何知识对新实例至关重要，语义知识对新任务至关重要

82fe34a5c7.en: FoundationGrasp — LLM + VLM knowledge drives generalizable task-oriented grasping across novel objects and tasks.
82fe34a5c7.zh: FoundationGrasp——大语言模型 + 视觉语言模型的知识推动了跨新物体和新任务的可泛化任务导向抓取。

2b8dfb26d4.en: Robotics in the Artificial Intelligence Era
2b8dfb26d4.zh: Robotics in the Artificial Intelligence Era

f176831b92.zh: {1}Ning Xi{/1} · 大语言模型驱动的机器人控制

1f8acefe9b.zh: 从任务规划到大语言模型

363a2596b0.en: Classical approach: build a task-plan sequence, then actions per task, executed by sensors + a control system
363a2596b0.zh: 传统方法：构建任务规划序列，再为每个任务设计动作，由传感器 + 控制系统执行

8635b43eaa.en: Now LLMs can control the robot directly, supplying the logical relationships and reasoning between actions
8635b43eaa.zh: 现在大语言模型可以直接控制机器人，提供动作之间的逻辑关系和推理

dd0c2bf6ac.zh: 大语言模型必须掌握什么

049cb980e2.en: Temporal relationships (e.g. past trajectory) and interactive spatial relationships (e.g. force to grasp a coffee cup)
049cb980e2.zh: 时间关系（例如过去的轨迹）和交互式空间关系（例如抓取咖啡杯所需的力）

6a505c5a4f.en: Needs a new way to represent information, including unstructured constraints; control should be vision-based, not vector-based
6a505c5a4f.zh: 需要一种新的信息表示方式，包括非结构化约束；控制应基于视觉，而不是基于向量

24326eaec1.en: LLM logical reasoning of motion (PaLM-style) vs robotic action: spatial sensing, world modeling, temporal/body acting, environment interaction
24326eaec1.zh: 大语言模型对运动的逻辑推理（PaLM 式）与机器人动作的差距：空间感知、世界建模、时间 / 身体行动、环境交互

4a42693be6.en: Framed as a Data-Driven vs Model-Driven challenge in AI
4a42693be6.zh: 被表述为 AI 中数据驱动与模型驱动的挑战

5755e26364.en: The gap between an LLM's logical reasoning and a robot motion generator's spatial / temporal / interactive needs.
5755e26364.zh: 大语言模型的逻辑推理与机器人运动生成器在空间 / 时间 / 交互方面的需求之间的差距。

11ca40f13b.zh: 大语言模型作为反馈控制器

1578531bba.en: Frame the LLM as a discrete-time nonlinear dynamic feedback controller with defined state, input and output
1578531bba.zh: 把大语言模型视为离散时间非线性动态反馈控制器，具有明确定义的状态、输入和输出

522a9336e6.en: An LLM-interaction loop generates responses that close the control loop
522a9336e6.zh: 大语言模型交互回路生成响应，从而闭合控制回路

e527dbcf23.en: ‘Diffusion for Actions’ generates actions for dynamic legged loco-manipulation
e527dbcf23.zh: “Diffusion for Actions”为动态足式移动操作生成动作

4db4a87453.en: ‘Diffusion for Actions’ — generating actions for dynamic legged loco-manipulation.
4db4a87453.zh: “Diffusion for Actions”——为动态足式移动操作生成动作。

38b9f0077e.en: Collaboration & Interaction of Human-Robot and Robot-Robot
38b9f0077e.zh: Collaboration & Interaction of Human-Robot and Robot-Robot

3edbd023e6.en: {1}Masayoshi Tomizuka{/1} · UC Berkeley · Mechanical Systems Control Lab
3edbd023e6.zh: {1}Masayoshi Tomizuka{/1} · UC Berkeley · Mechanical Systems Control Lab

b9df339c6b.zh: 高效、不保守的协作机器人

b9e4cfc547.en: Robots raise efficiency, but automated robots tend to become conservative and slow the whole system
b9e4cfc547.zh: 机器人提高了效率，但自动化机器人往往趋于保守，拖慢整个系统

030eca9d8f.en: Challenge: design co-robot behavior so efficiency isn't sacrificed for safety
030eca9d8f.zh: 挑战：设计协作机器人的行为，使效率不因安全而被牺牲

ef598e36f7.en: Safe & Efficient Robot Collaboration System in three tasks: environment monitoring, task planning, safe control
ef598e36f7.zh: 安全高效的机器人协作系统，包含三项任务：环境监测、任务规划、安全控制

f932a9609b.en: Trade-off framed as Efficiency vs Safety under Computation vs Uncertainty
f932a9609b.zh: 权衡被表述为在计算与不确定性之下的效率与安全

fa6efd4514.en: A two-part controller with a safety-checker stage; uses an offline-learned human-motion prediction + nominal optimal control
fa6efd4514.zh: 带有安全检查环节的两部分控制器；使用离线学习的人体运动预测 + 标称最优控制

9d85595421.en: RL for palletizing: pallet height-map + box size → feasibility map; task planning via RL with action masking
9d85595421.zh: 用于码垛的强化学习（RL）：托盘高度图 + 箱体尺寸 → 可行性图；通过带动作掩码的强化学习进行任务规划

c515cca770.en: Methods: SERoCS, Conditional Behavior Prediction, Courteous Autonomous Cars
c515cca770.zh: 方法：SERoCS、Conditional Behavior Prediction、Courteous Autonomous Cars

e4a37d9617.en: The SERoCS controller structure — a two-part controller with human-motion prediction and a safety-checker stage.
e4a37d9617.zh: SERoCS 控制器结构——带有人体运动预测和安全检查环节的两部分控制器。

a90813a6ce.en: Logistics Application of Tactile Sensing with Smart Grippers
a90813a6ce.zh: Logistics Application of Tactile Sensing with Smart Grippers

e3746faf9d.en: {1}Hannah Stuart{/1} · UC Berkeley · Embodied Dexterity Group
e3746faf9d.zh: {1}Hannah Stuart{/1} · UC Berkeley · Embodied Dexterity Group

00a82a8abe.en: Flexible logistics application of tactile sensing with smart grippers; one gripper alone may not suffice
00a82a8abe.zh: 智能夹爪触觉传感在物流中的灵活应用；单个夹爪可能不够

0282222758.en: Goal: find the optimum grasp position without an image sensor, using tactile feedback
0282222758.zh: 目标：不使用图像传感器，借助触觉反馈找到最佳抓取位置

9020e201bc.en: Grasp location is selected visually; grasp success is used as binary feedback
9020e201bc.zh: 抓取位置通过视觉选定；抓取是否成功作为二元反馈

3ab0679f5c.en: Grasp location is not modified after contact is made (ICRA 2015, Amazon Picking Challenge)
3ab0679f5c.zh: 接触之后不再修改抓取位置（ICRA 2015，Amazon Picking Challenge）

facd603b1f.en: Visual-tactile grasping — grasp location chosen by vision with binary success feedback (ICRA 2015).
facd603b1f.zh: 视觉-触觉抓取——抓取位置由视觉选定，并以二元成功反馈（ICRA 2015）。

a689b5b67a.en: Amoeba-Inspired Self-Healing Electronic Slime as Wearable Motion Sensors
a689b5b67a.zh: Amoeba-Inspired Self-Healing Electronic Slime as Wearable Motion Sensors

d202862a87.zh: {1}Wen Jung Li{/1} · 可穿戴 MEMS 传感

ef21ea63e6.zh: 受变形虫启发的自愈传感器

e49ba8c171.en: A self-healing electronic ‘slime’ material for wearable motion sensing, inspired by amoeba
e49ba8c171.zh: 一种受变形虫启发、用于可穿戴运动传感的自愈电子“黏液”材料

22d8105ffe.en: Monitors motion / behavior (demonstrated on a mouse) with a wearable MEMS sensor
22d8105ffe.zh: 借助可穿戴 MEMS 传感器监测运动 / 行为（以小鼠为例演示）

2d7ba44cf5.en: Skin-conformal sensor fabricated via micro 3D printing
2d7ba44cf5.zh: 通过微型 3D 打印制造的贴合皮肤的传感器

2b6fedc8d4.en: Targets human–robot interaction through wearable motion capture
2b6fedc8d4.zh: 通过可穿戴动作捕捉面向人机交互

947934df93.en: Enabling Autonomy with Robust Perception and Remote Intervention
947934df93.zh: Enabling Autonomy with Robust Perception and Remote Intervention

ae896192b9.zh: {1}Dan Wei Wang{/1} · 鲁棒感知与自主

77e5dab16c.zh: 恶劣条件下的鲁棒感知

e993c14ebd.en: Current perception & navigation technologies are limited to normal conditions
e993c14ebd.zh: 目前的感知与导航技术仅限于正常条件

79d4da058d.en: ‘Adverse is various, adverse is challenging’: inclement weather causes appearance change, domain shift and urban haze
79d4da058d.zh: “恶劣情形多种多样，恶劣情形极具挑战”：恶劣天气会造成外观变化、域偏移和城市雾霾

a211da1c5c.en: Perception and cognition algorithms are vulnerable to adverse events — motivating remote intervention as a fallback
a211da1c5c.zh: 感知与认知算法容易受恶劣事件影响——这促使把远程干预作为后备手段

a33e95003c.en: ‘Adverse is challenging’ — inclement weather causes the domain shift that degrades perception.
a33e95003c.zh: “恶劣情形极具挑战”——恶劣天气造成的域偏移会降低感知性能。

777ac5e633.en: Technological Development for Smart Transport in Hong Kong
777ac5e633.zh: Technological Development for Smart Transport in Hong Kong

5bab49831b.en: Systems typically have many competing objectives (e.g. quiet, autonomous)
5bab49831b.zh: 系统通常有许多相互竞争的目标（例如安静、自主）

7f88d1e9e7.en: Don't build the system first and try to control it afterwards — co-design controls and mechanical design simultaneously
7f88d1e9e7.zh: 不要先建好系统再设法控制它——要同时协同设计控制与机械设计

804d92407f.en: Treat control theory as a lens and a tool from the very start
804d92407f.zh: 从一开始就把控制理论当作视角和工具

8c46087d95.en: Designing smart-transport systems — co-design controls and mechanical design for competing objectives.
8c46087d95.zh: 设计智能交通系统——针对相互竞争的目标，协同设计控制与机械设计。

d270775297.en: Foundation models are moving into the loop: LLMs / VLMs replace hand-built task-planning pipelines, supplying semantic, spatial, temporal and commonsense knowledge.
d270775297.zh: 基础模型正进入闭环：大语言模型 / 视觉语言模型取代手工构建的任务规划流水线，提供语义、空间、时间和常识知识。

7e4100bbef.en: Task-oriented grasping is the benchmark problem — generalizing across novel objects, tasks and grippers via multi-modal fusion (BERT + CLIP + PointNet++).
7e4100bbef.zh: 任务导向抓取是基准问题——通过多模态融合（BERT + CLIP + PointNet++）泛化到新的物体、任务和夹爪。

cf37ff7ce3.en: Tactile and wearable sensing push perception beyond cameras (smart grippers, self-healing skin sensors).
cf37ff7ce3.zh: 触觉和可穿戴传感使感知超越摄像头（智能夹爪、自愈皮肤传感器）。

8b02614ddd.en: Reframe the LLM itself as a dynamic feedback controller and the reasoning layer for motion — from planner to closed-loop element.
8b02614ddd.zh: 把大语言模型本身重新视为动态反馈控制器和运动的推理层——从规划器变为闭环要素。

9e9a58308e.en: Universal, generalizable manipulation policies usable across many household robots and gripper types.
9e9a58308e.zh: 通用、可泛化的操作策略，可用于众多家用机器人和各类夹爪。

ad00ed00df.en: Robots that collaborate safely and efficiently with humans, without defaulting to conservative behavior.
ad00ed00df.zh: 能与人安全高效协作、且不默认采取保守行为的机器人。

ff919a7ee9.en: Persistent gaps (efficiency-vs-safety; ~90% grasp vs ~67% full-manipulation success) show autonomy is bottlenecked by force feedback, relative-pose modeling and conservatism — not perception alone.
ff919a7ee9.zh: 持续存在的差距（效率与安全；抓取成功率约 90% 对完整操作成功率约 67%）表明，自主性的瓶颈在于力反馈、相对位姿建模和保守性——而不仅是感知。

dcab9d5511.en: Robustness under adverse conditions and remote intervention are needed before deployment at scale.
dcab9d5511.zh: 大规模部署之前，需要恶劣条件下的鲁棒性和远程干预。

182df6093f.en: Co-design control with mechanical design — treat control theory as a tool from the start, not an afterthought.
182df6093f.zh: 控制与机械设计协同设计——从一开始就把控制理论当作工具，而不是事后补救。

3c81c49b62.zh: HKSTP 2024 — Symposium on Innovative Robotics — Tech Insight 报告

40f8b7074f.en:
Trends

  • Foundation models are moving into the loop: LLMs / VLMs replace hand-built task-planning pipelines, supplying semantic, spatial, temporal and commonsense knowledge.
  • Task-oriented grasping is the benchmark problem — generalizing across novel objects, tasks and grippers via multi-modal fusion (BERT + CLIP + PointNet++).
  • Tactile and wearable sensing push perception beyond cameras (smart grippers, self-healing skin sensors).

Vision

  • Reframe the LLM itself as a dynamic feedback controller and the reasoning layer for motion — from planner to closed-loop element.
  • Universal, generalizable manipulation policies usable across many household robots and gripper types.
  • Robots that collaborate safely and efficiently with humans, without defaulting to conservative behavior.

Implications for us

  • Persistent gaps (efficiency-vs-safety; ~90% grasp vs ~67% full-manipulation success) show autonomy is bottlenecked by force feedback, relative-pose modeling and conservatism — not perception alone.
  • Robustness under adverse conditions and remote intervention are needed before deployment at scale.
  • Co-design control with mechanical design — treat control theory as a tool from the start, not an afterthought.
40f8b7074f.zh:
趋势

  • 基础模型正在进入控制回路：LLM / VLM 取代手工搭建的任务规划流水线，提供语义、空间、时间和常识知识。
  • 任务导向抓取是基准测试问题——通过多模态融合（BERT + CLIP + PointNet++）在新物体、新任务和新夹爪之间实现泛化。
  • 触觉和可穿戴传感使感知不再局限于摄像头（智能夹爪、自修复皮肤传感器）。

愿景

  • 把 LLM 本身重新定义为动态反馈控制器和运动推理层——从规划器变为闭环环节。
  • 可用于多种家用机器人和夹爪类型的通用、可泛化操作策略。
  • 能与人安全、高效协作，而不默认采取保守行为的机器人。

对我们的启示

  • 持续存在的差距（效率与安全；约 90% 的抓取成功率对比约 67% 的完整操作成功率）说明，自主能力的瓶颈在于力反馈、相对位姿建模和保守性，而不只是感知。
  • 规模化部署之前，需要具备恶劣条件下的鲁棒性和远程干预能力。
  • 让控制与机械设计协同设计——从一开始就把控制理论当作工具，而不是事后补救。

3130e74a87.en: INSIGHT 01 · Foundation models for grasping & control
3130e74a87.zh: 洞察 01 · 面向抓取与控制的基础模型

6edc2f812d.zh: Hong Zhang · 任务导向抓取 · FoundationGrasp

2c23d1fc16.en: • Task-Oriented Grasping (TOG) = decide which object to grasp and how; learning beats classical grasping but is data-hungry
2c23d1fc16.zh: • 任务导向抓取（TOG）= 决定抓取哪个物体以及如何抓取；学习方法优于传统抓取，但需要大量数据

5923dc809a.en: • Use foundation models (LLMs + VLMs) to transfer knowledge and generalize across novel objects, tasks and grippers
5923dc809a.zh: • 使用基础模型（LLM + VLM）迁移知识，并在新物体、新任务和新夹爪之间泛化

b33e48b880.en: • Goal: from an RGB image + a language instruction (object + task) + gripper geometry, output a 6-DoF grasp pose
b33e48b880.zh: • 目标：输入 RGB 图像 + 语言指令（物体 + 任务）+ 夹爪几何，输出 6 自由度抓取位姿

401ccca321.en: • Pipeline: data generation → multi-modal feature representation → task-oriented grasp evaluation → loss
401ccca321.zh: • 流水线：数据生成 → 多模态特征表示 → 任务导向抓取评估 → 损失

ed5992b697.en: • Object/grasp encoder (PointNet++), semantic encoder (BERT), geometric encoder (CLIP), trained with binary cross-entropy
ed5992b697.zh: • 物体 / 抓取编码器（PointNet++）、语义编码器（BERT）、几何编码器（CLIP），使用二元交叉熵训练

a63a2ad002.en: • LLM prompts generate language descriptions; web image retrieval augments visual diversity
a63a2ad002.zh: • 通过 LLM 提示词生成语言描述；通过网络图像检索增强视觉多样性

c785bf6222.en: • GraspCLIP reaches ~83% mAP but struggles on novel classes; FoundationGrasp adds commonsense reasoning
c785bf6222.zh: • GraspCLIP 的 mAP 约为 83%，但在新类别上表现不佳；FoundationGrasp 加入了常识推理

4112086689.en: • ~90% grasp success across nine manipulation tasks, but full-manipulation success ~67% (limited relative-pose modeling, no force feedback)
4112086689.zh: • 在 9 个操作任务中抓取成功率约 90%，但完整操作成功率约 67%（相对位姿建模有限，没有力反馈）

6fcdb9d832.en: • Ablations: geometric knowledge is key for novel instances, semantic knowledge for novel tasks
6fcdb9d832.zh: • 消融实验：几何知识对新实例至关重要，语义知识对新任务至关重要

0d1e7517b2.en: INSIGHT 02 · Foundation models for grasping & control
0d1e7517b2.zh: 洞察 02 · 面向抓取与控制的基础模型

d034a2de1a.zh: Ning Xi · LLM 驱动的机器人控制

5abe14b595.en: • Classical approach: build a task-plan sequence, then actions per task, executed by sensors + a control system
5abe14b595.zh: • 传统方法：先构建任务规划序列，再为每个任务设计动作，由传感器 + 控制系统执行

534c434396.en: • Now LLMs can control the robot directly, supplying the logical relationships and reasoning between actions
534c434396.zh: • 如今 LLM 可以直接控制机器人，提供动作之间的逻辑关系和推理

cd0d8ea027.en: • Temporal relationships (e.g. past trajectory) and interactive spatial relationships (e.g. force to grasp a coffee cup)
cd0d8ea027.zh: • 时间关系（例如过去的轨迹）和交互式空间关系（例如抓取咖啡杯所需的力）

ab5ac1693d.en: • Needs a new way to represent information, including unstructured constraints; control should be vision-based, not vector-based
ab5ac1693d.zh: • 需要一种新的信息表示方式，包括非结构化约束；控制应基于视觉，而不是基于向量

ba1b90d159.en: • LLM logical reasoning of motion (PaLM-style) vs robotic action: spatial sensing, world modeling, temporal/body acting, environment interaction
ba1b90d159.zh: • LLM 的运动逻辑推理（PaLM 式）与机器人动作的差距：空间感知、世界建模、时间 / 身体行动、环境交互

84aa1658a7.en: • Framed as a Data-Driven vs Model-Driven challenge in AI
84aa1658a7.zh: • 被归结为 AI 中数据驱动与模型驱动之间的挑战

922cd5f07b.en: INSIGHT 03 · Foundation models for grasping & control
922cd5f07b.zh: 洞察 03 · 面向抓取与控制的基础模型

1f29af1b6b.en: • Frame the LLM as a discrete-time nonlinear dynamic feedback controller with defined state, input and output
1f29af1b6b.zh: • 将 LLM 视为离散时间非线性动态反馈控制器，具有明确定义的状态、输入和输出

11f06db108.en: • An LLM-interaction loop generates responses that close the control loop
11f06db108.zh: • LLM 交互回路生成响应，从而闭合控制回路

fa0716cda1.en: • ‘Diffusion for Actions’ generates actions for dynamic legged loco-manipulation
fa0716cda1.zh: • ‘Diffusion for Actions’ 为动态足式移动操作生成动作

ad21df3cf1.zh: 洞察 04 · 人机协作与感知

0fc2643375.en: Masayoshi Tomizuka · UC Berkeley · Mechanical Systems Control Lab
0fc2643375.zh: Masayoshi Tomizuka · UC Berkeley · Mechanical Systems Control Lab

086b786d12.zh: 高效、非保守的协作机器人

4de179337e.en: • Robots raise efficiency, but automated robots tend to become conservative and slow the whole system
4de179337e.zh: • 机器人提高了效率，但自动化机器人往往趋于保守，拖慢整个系统

c8a1385223.en: • Challenge: design co-robot behavior so efficiency isn't sacrificed for safety
c8a1385223.zh: • 挑战：设计协作机器人的行为，使效率不会为安全而牺牲

cf4d415d39.en: • Safe & Efficient Robot Collaboration System in three tasks: environment monitoring, task planning, safe control
cf4d415d39.zh: • 安全高效的机器人协作系统，包含三项任务：环境监测、任务规划、安全控制

51330baa0d.en: • Trade-off framed as Efficiency vs Safety under Computation vs Uncertainty
51330baa0d.zh: • 权衡被表述为计算与不确定性之下的效率与安全

202ef1b7fe.en: • A two-part controller with a safety-checker stage; uses an offline-learned human-motion prediction + nominal optimal control
202ef1b7fe.zh: • 带有安全检查阶段的两部分控制器；使用离线学习的人体运动预测 + 标称最优控制

3d3a6230a7.en: • RL for palletizing: pallet height-map + box size → feasibility map; task planning via RL with action masking
3d3a6230a7.zh: • 用于码垛的 RL：托盘高度图 + 箱体尺寸 → 可行性图；通过带动作掩码的 RL 进行任务规划

4225beae9f.en: • Methods: SERoCS, Conditional Behavior Prediction, Courteous Autonomous Cars
4225beae9f.zh: • 方法：SERoCS、Conditional Behavior Prediction、Courteous Autonomous Cars

881a06b8e2.zh: 洞察 05 · 人机协作与感知

9694e38a3b.en: Hannah Stuart · UC Berkeley · Embodied Dexterity Group
9694e38a3b.zh: Hannah Stuart · UC Berkeley · Embodied Dexterity Group

d3f1229711.en: • Flexible logistics application of tactile sensing with smart grippers; one gripper alone may not suffice
d3f1229711.zh: • 触觉传感与智能夹爪在灵活物流中的应用；单个夹爪可能不够

3b81e44510.en: • Goal: find the optimum grasp position without an image sensor, using tactile feedback
3b81e44510.zh: • 目标：不使用图像传感器，利用触觉反馈找到最佳抓取位置

5f77c1abc2.en: • Grasp location is selected visually; grasp success is used as binary feedback
5f77c1abc2.zh: • 通过视觉选择抓取位置；抓取成败作为二元反馈

794be6d8e0.en: • Grasp location is not modified after contact is made (ICRA 2015, Amazon Picking Challenge)
794be6d8e0.zh: • 接触之后不再修改抓取位置（ICRA 2015，Amazon Picking Challenge）

38627c99d5.zh: 洞察 06 · 人机协作与感知

6db844f380.en: Wen Jung Li · wearable MEMS sensing
6db844f380.zh: Wen Jung Li · 可穿戴 MEMS 传感

4f1e63154a.zh: 受变形虫启发的自修复传感器

2ba31230a4.en: • A self-healing electronic ‘slime’ material for wearable motion sensing, inspired by amoeba
2ba31230a4.zh: • 一种受变形虫启发、用于可穿戴运动传感的自修复电子‘黏液’材料

105b741ab1.en: • Monitors motion / behavior (demonstrated on a mouse) with a wearable MEMS sensor
105b741ab1.zh: • 通过可穿戴 MEMS 传感器监测运动 / 行为（以小鼠为例演示）

e4f3a2b6e1.en: • Skin-conformal sensor fabricated via micro 3D printing
e4f3a2b6e1.zh: • 通过微型 3D 打印制造的贴合皮肤的传感器

3f3182dc98.en: • Targets human–robot interaction through wearable motion capture
3f3182dc98.zh: • 通过可穿戴动作捕捉面向人机交互

efa2ba3463.en: Dan Wei Wang · robust perception & autonomy
efa2ba3463.zh: Dan Wei Wang · 鲁棒感知与自主

4f005d43dd.zh: 恶劣条件下的鲁棒感知

185fca4136.en: • Current perception & navigation technologies are limited to normal conditions
185fca4136.zh: • 当前的感知与导航技术仅限于正常条件

a90da8ee95.en: • ‘Adverse is various, adverse is challenging’: inclement weather causes appearance change, domain shift and urban haze
a90da8ee95.zh: • ‘恶劣条件多种多样，恶劣条件极具挑战’：恶劣天气会导致外观变化、域偏移和城市雾霾

f309b895c8.en: • Perception and cognition algorithms are vulnerable to adverse events — motivating remote intervention as a fallback
f309b895c8.zh: • 感知与认知算法容易受到恶劣事件影响——这促使把远程干预作为后备方案

6a4b0cc2e8.zh: 洞察 08 · 鲁棒自主与智慧交通

b2203fba57.en: • Systems typically have many competing objectives (e.g. quiet, autonomous)
b2203fba57.zh: • 系统通常有许多相互竞争的目标（例如安静、自主）

2e3e869153.en: • Don't build the system first and try to control it afterwards — co-design controls and mechanical design simultaneously
2e3e869153.zh: • 不要先建好系统再设法控制它——要同时协同设计控制与机械设计

f71e47eadf.en: • Treat control theory as a lens and a tool from the very start
f71e47eadf.zh: • 从一开始就把控制理论当作一种视角和工具
